extDescription.message: All-in-one extension for page jumping, search focusing, tab control, tab search, and batch link operations.

pjPanelDesc.message: Move to the next page with automatic analysis or manual settings.

pjConflictNote.message: Some keys may conflict with website shortcuts or browser operations.

pjConflictNote2.message: If that happens, please change to another key.

pjConflictNote3.message: Does not work while typing in input fields or while Tab Search is open.

pjGoogleEnable.message: Use dedicated jump on Google Search

pjGooglePriority.message: This takes priority over other rules.

pjMouseBack.message: Use mouse back button for previous page

pjMouseForward.message: Use mouse forward button for next page

pjSampleBody.message:
Query: Google → host: google.com / pattern: start={n} / step: 10
Path: Gizmodo → host: gizmodo.jp / pattern: /articles/{n} / step: 1
Offset: GIGAZINE → host: gigazine.net / pattern: /P{n}/ / step: 20

searchKeyNote1.message: * Ctrl + Space and Alt + Space cannot be used. Other Space combinations are allowed.

searchKeyNote2.message: * Some keys may conflict with website shortcuts or browser operations.

searchKeyNote3.message: If that happens, please change to another key.

stsPanelDesc.message: Focus the search box on the website and type immediately.

stsNote1.message: Each time you press the configured key, the focus cycles through search box candidates on the page.

stsNote2.message: If a site is hard to target, adjust the initial position in Site-specific Settings.

stsNote3.message: Some keys may conflict with website shortcuts or browser operations.

stsNote4.message: If that happens, please change to another key.

stsSiteOrderNote1.message: Do not enter the full URL. Enter the host name without "https://" and anything after the first slash.

stsSiteOrderExampleLine1.message: If you want the second box on https://search.yahoo.co.jp/realtime/

stsSiteOrderHint.message: 1 = first box, 2 = second box, 3 = third box

linkPanelDesc.message: Select links on the page and open them in the background.

linkCheckboxPositionNote.message: Choose where the check mark is displayed

linkMinSizeNote1.message: Specify the minimum size of links to target.

linkMinSizeNote2.message: * If set too small, buttons such as Like may also be included.

aboutBackupNote1.message: Export and import the currently saved settings as text.

aboutBackupNote2.message: This also includes PJ rules and saved sites.

aboutBackupNote3.message: Importing will completely replace the current saved contents.

pjStatusRuleApplied.message: Applied the site settings to the edit form.

pjStatusRuleRemoved.message: Removed the PJ rule from the list. Confirm with Save Settings.

pjStatusRuleEnabledUpdated.message: Updated the enabled state. Confirm with Save Settings.

stsSiteRemoveStatus.message: Removed the site-specific setting from the list. Confirm with Save Settings.

pjValidateTabSearchAndKts.message: Tab Search key and KtS key cannot be the same.

pjValidatePageJumpForwardAndTabSearch.message: Page Jump forward key and Tab Search key cannot be the same.

pjValidatePageJumpForwardAndKts.message: Page Jump forward key and KtS key cannot be the same.

pjValidatePageJumpBackAndTabSearch.message: Page Jump back key and Tab Search key cannot be the same.

pjValidatePageJumpBackAndKts.message: Page Jump back key and KtS key cannot be the same.

pjValidatePageJumpForwardAndBack.message: Page Jump forward key and back key cannot be the same.

pjValidateGooglePageJumpForwardAndTabSea.message: Google Page Jump forward key and Tab Search key cannot be the same.

pjValidateGooglePageJumpForwardAndKts.message: Google Page Jump forward key and KtS key cannot be the same.

pjValidateGooglePageJumpBackAndTabSearch.message: Google Page Jump back key and Tab Search key cannot be the same.

pjValidateGooglePageJumpBackAndKts.message: Google Page Jump back key and KtS key cannot be the same.

pjValidateGooglePageJumpForwardAndBack.message: Google Page Jump forward key and back key cannot be the same.

backupImportEmpty.message: Please paste the text to import.

tabHistorySectionDesc.message: Move back and forward through the tabs you actually used.

tabHistoryNote1.message: Back uses Alt+Q by default. Forward uses Alt+W by default.

tabHistoryValidateBackAndForward.message: Tab History back key and forward key cannot be the same.

externalIntegrationDesc.message: Information used when another extension, such as Munus Gesture, calls supported Tabmission features.

externalIntegrationIdSubLabel.message: If Munus Gesture cannot connect, copy this ID and paste it there.
